name: io.github.bdog720/oraclarr
title: Oraclarr
description: Read-only-by-default MCP server for diagnosing a self-hosted arr stack (Sonarr, Radarr & more).

environmentVariables.name: ORACLARR_SONARR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Sonarr base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8989. Every service is ORACLARR_<NAME>_URL plus ORACLARR_<NAME>_API_KEY; the README lists the types.

environmentVariables.name: ORACLARR_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a config.yaml as an alternative to ORACLARR_* variables. See docs/config-file.md in the repository.
